<subject>Lumière Santé HR System: Email Undeliverable: Cannot locate you</subject>
<body>
We received your email addressed to p953@trialttech.com. Unfortunately, we cannot find your username or email address listed as a current employee or registered user of the Lumière Santé HR System.

Access to the Lumière Santé HR System is free for all employees and allows you to view your payslips, manage your leave requests, update your personal information, access internal training modules, and more. However, to submit official requests or access certain confidential sections, you must be a registered and verified user. For details, click here: https://hrportal.lumieresante.fr/

If you are a current employee and believe you've received this email in error, please contact our HR Support Desk at: suzanne.bodin@lumieresante.fr

For your convenience, we've included the text of your personal message below:

To: p953@trialttech.com
Subject: RE: Lumière Santé HR System - You've Got Mail: Hi Plucci!
Hello,

Thanks for sending me an email. I appreciate the interest and found
your profile to be interesting as well. But, I feel I'm at a
disadvantage due to the fact that your profile doesn't contain a
picture. Are you sending a picture over later, or making me guess as to
what you look like? Drop me a line and we can hash this out.

Antoine
</body>
<quoted>

From: p953@trialttech.com

rackingid=0

The following is my profile text:

I never thought I'd be using a "dating service". But I'm open to trying
new things - so let's give it a try. I'm an outgoing, positive, fun
person. I LOVE to travela nd experince new places and cultures. I'm
always learning something new - right now it's the guitar. I'm also
really happy being alone with myself to read, write, or just putz
around. I love kids, and they love me - probably because I'm pretty much
a kid at heart still. I'm very close to my family and have probably too
many good friends - I spend a lot of time keeping up with them all.
